news_items.headline: Hyatt Hotels (NYSE:H) Reaches New 12-Month High Following Analyst Upgrade
news_items.summary: Shares hit a fresh 12-month high after an analyst upgrade. Stock cited around $185 in late May.

news_items.headline: Hyatt Hotels Unveils Strategy and Expands Share Buyback at Investor Day
news_items.summary: At its May 28 Investor Day, Hyatt presented a three-year outlook through 2028 (RevPAR, EBITDA, rooms growth, FCF) and its board approved an additional $1 billion share repurchase program.

news_items.headline: Mizuho raises Hyatt Hotels stock price target on growth outlook
news_items.summary: Mizuho raised its price target to $221 from $219 and maintained an Outperform rating after Investor Day, saying all presented metrics exceeded expectations (~19% upside from ~$185).

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: Mizuho raised PT to $221 (Outperform) on 2026-05-28 after Investor Day. Older context (outside 7-day window): Bernstein raised to $202 Outperform on 2026-05-15; JPMorgan raised to $186 Overweight on 2026-05-05. Consensus rating 'Buy' across ~15-23 analysts; high target $224, low $150.

earnings_context.notes: Q1 2026 reported ~2026-05-04 (already priced in): EPS $0.63 beat $0.58 est (+8.6%), revenue $1.73B roughly in line; system-wide RevPAR +5.4%, record ~151,000-room pipeline, World of Hyatt ~66M members (+18% YoY); full-year RevPAR guide raised to 2-4%. Next near-term catalyst is the May 28 Investor Day three-year outlook through 2028, not earnings. Next earnings est. early Aug 2026 (date approximate).
